reply_text:
I didn't log 25 November for Brackenwater Freight Co. I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread to say it doesn't match what the records show:

- The signed renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025) gives the renewal date, the end of the current term, as 30 November 2026.
- The account notes (last updated 30 Sep 2026) also say 30 November.
- One CRM note from February 2026 gives a third date, 31 December 2026.
- Nothing I found says 25 November.

I asked whether 25 November is a new date agreed with the customer or an internal deadline, for example getting it signed before Thanksgiving week. I also said that a real change should have paperwork behind it from Marcus Lindqvist (the account owner) or the deal desk, and that I'll treat 30 November as the date until she confirms. The reply only gives dates and names no money figures. Everyone in that channel can see it: Ilse, Dana Okafor and Marcus, all on the account's team.
